test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

My friend said, "Hello! What are you doing here?"

options.text: My friend wished me and asked me what was I doing here.
My friend greeted me and asked me what I was doing there.
My friend said hello and asked me what was I doing there.
My friend said hello to me and asked what were you doing here.

solution:
The correct answer is **'My friend greeted me and asked me what I was doing there.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows: 
 
 
• In the given sentence rules 'Optative sentence' will apply. 
 
• The sentence that has the notion of 'wish, pray, curse, bless, alas, etc.' are called Optative Sentences. 
 
• Here, in the given sentence 'said'__ will be changed into__ 'greeted'.__
 
• Commas and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• 'Hello!' will be removed. The word *__'Hello'__ *in the indirect speech accounts for this__ ____'greet__' 
 
• The 'what' conjunction will be added to make a meaningful sentence. Because '**wh**-' words do not change and are used as a **conjunction**.
 
• 'are' will be changed into 'was'. (Direct: Present to Indirect: Past)
 
• '**here**' will be changed into '**there**'
 
• 'you' will be changed into 'I'.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

 ​​​

__Correct Answer:__ *My friend greeted me and asked me what I was doing there.*
